name: AZCubing Hamilton Fall 2017

venue.name: Hamilton High School
venue.details: On the West side of S Arizona Ave, just North of W Ocotillo Rd and South of W Appleby Rd

information:
The registration is a $15 flat fee

Due to the size of this venue, there is a 100 competitor limit.

To reach the gymnasium, go to the front entrance of the school and turn left down the main hallway. You will see a sign directing you to the gymnasium from here.
